Equal-mass KCl seeding in a 2-D bin model: a critical diameter sets the sign of the rain response and shrinks as the background gets more polluted.

<div class="manual-post-meta">2026-09-07 · Jinu</div>

### [Experiment 7. Reproducing the Particle-Size Effect of Ren et al. (2025) in a 0-D Parcel](posts/experiments/2026-09-07-ren2025-parcel-replication/index.qmd)

Rain-onset shifts in a PySDM parcel reproduce the suppression-to-enhancement switch and the regime ordering of the critical diameter, at about half the paper's values.
:::

Where the 6 mm limit comes from, and whether the sign pattern of Experiment 5 survives five terminal-velocity formulas (3,800 runs).
